subtitle: Tracking Florida's 2026 property tax elimination proposals and related reforms
current_status_summary: Official Florida Senate bill pages reviewed on June 1, 2026 listed SJR 2-F (Save our Homes from Excessive Property Taxes) and SB 4-F (Property Tax Administration) with a last action of June 1, 2026 placing them on the Special Order Calendar for June 2, 2026 (if received). Official Florida Senate bill pages reviewed on June 1, 2026 listed HJR 1-F and HB 3-F with a last action of June 1, 2026 adding them to the State Affairs Committee agenda. The June 1, 2026 Senate bill-actions page listed those actions and displayed a notice that the Senate will convene on Tuesday, June 2, 2026, at 9:00 a.m., or upon the call of the President. A Governor proclamation dated May 27, 2026 stated Special Session 2026-F would commence at 10:00 AM on Monday, June 1, 2026 and extend no later than 11:59 PM on Wednesday, June 3, 2026. CS/CS/HJR 203 passed the Florida House but died in Senate Appropriations during the regular session.
latest_update: Bill pages reviewed on June 1, 2026 show SJR 2-F and SB 4-F moved from the June 1 agenda checkpoint to the June 2 Special Order Calendar (if received), and House counterparts HJR 1-F and HB 3-F were added to the State Affairs Committee agenda.
expected_next: Watch June 2 committee or floor movement during Special Session 2026-F, Department of State ballot records, and any Revenue Estimating Conference or EDR fiscal materials tied to these bill versions.
